item.description:
Carry the notch anywhere round your screen by its six dots — and new versions now ask first, right in the notch.

  • Six dots to carry the notch. Hover the settings button, hold the dots beside it and drag: the notch follows along any edge and round the corners.
  • Round the corners like liquid. Dragged by the dots or with ⌥, it flows round each corner and settles where you let go.
  • Updates ask first, in the notch, with Update and Later, and install there with their progress.
  • A notch that pours: the settings arc and dots come out of it and go back in like goo.
  • The percentage beside your Mac's notch, with one ring, on the other side of the camera housing.
  • Switching a provider on no longer hangs the app.
